title: Designing AI Pipelines for Decision-Ready ITSM Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2608.12670v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: IT service management (ITSM) systems accumulate large volumes of heterogeneous ticket data that are difficult for sales and executive stakeholders to convert into actionable intelligence. This paper presents a sociotechnical AI pipeline, designed and evaluated following design science research principles, that transforms raw ITSM exports into a multilevel decision-support artifact. The pipeline combines LLM-based schema normalization, HDBSCAN sub-topic clustering, and hierarchical agglomerative clustering to generate executive-facing Main-topics and granular Sub-topics. A stakeholder evaluation across six artifacts and five raters from Sales Engineering and customer success roles shows that all four decision-support metrics, interpretability, actionability, trust, and likelihood of use, on average exceed 4.0 out of 5.0, with trust as the most consistent signal. The findings position ITSM analytics as an Information Systems (IS) problem o

translated_title: 面向决策就绪型ITSM智能的AI管道设计
translated_abstract: IT服务管理（ITSM）系统积累了大量的异构工单数据，这些数据对于销售和高管利益相关者而言难以转化为可操作的智能。本文提出了一种社会技术性AI管道，遵循设计科学研究原则进行设计和评估，将原始ITSM导出数据转化为多层次的决策支持工件。该管道结合了基于LLM的架构规范化、HDBSCAN子主题聚类和层次凝聚聚类，以生成面向高管的主主题和细粒度子主题。来自销售工程和客户成功角色的六项工件和五位评估者的利益相关者评估显示，所有四项决策支持指标——可解释性、可操作性、信任度和使用可能性——平均得分均超过4.0（满分5.0），其中信任度是最一致的信号。研究结果将ITSM分析定位为信息系统（IS）问题。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合LLM规范化和聚类算法的社会技术AI管道，将ITSM工单数据转化为多层级决策支持工具，经评估显示其在高管决策中具有高可解释性、可操作性和信任度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a sociotechnical AI pipeline combining LLM normalization and clustering algorithms to transform ITSM ticket data into multilevel decision-support artifacts, with evaluation showing high interpretability, actionability, and trust for executive decision-making.
